notices.loginRequired: Sign in to upload a document and have your profile filled in automatically.
notices.offline: Offline — analyzing a document requires a connection. Try again once you're back online.

upload.prompt: Take a photo or import a file
upload.cvHint: Your CV fills in your name, job, education, and languages by itself.

scanning.notice: Reading the document takes about fifteen seconds. You can leave this screen open.

review.keptAsEntered: Kept as you entered it: {value}. The document says something different.

toast.documentSavedNothingNew: Document saved — nothing new to add to your profile.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
errors.fileRejected: File rejected: PDF, JPG, or PNG, 10 MB maximum.

errors.applyFailed: Unable to apply this information to your profile.
